Maintain IP/Vlan schemas and configuration standards. review_candidates.description: Mission We’re looking for a network engineer with deep data center and Kubernetes networking experience to own networking across GroqMetal’s management plane and tenant clusters. You will own network architecture, configuration, security, and production operations—from host and cluster networking through data center fabrics to edge peering and interconnects. You’ll manage changes through fabric managers, automation, and GitOps, backed by a detailed understanding of the protocols, packet paths, and failure behavior underneath them. You’ll turn customer connectivity, isolation, and performance requirements into managed platform capabilities. Success means customers can provision and use networking reliably, tenant boundaries are demonstrably enforced, and network changes and failures can be diagnosed and resolved without reconstructing the system by hand. Responsibilities & Opportunities In This Role Networking product capabilities: Translate customer connectivity, isolation, access, and performance requirements into supported platform features. Define how those features are requested, provisioned, changed, observed, and removed throughout their lifecycle. Tenant and node network lifecycle: Build Kubernetes-native automation to create, modify, and remove tenant networks and manage node membership through provisioning, scaling, repair, replacement, and reassignment. Verify isolation and connectivity at each transition, recover safely from partial failures, and remove stale configuration before resources are reassigned. Data center routing and connectivity: Own dynamic configuration of tenant networks, BGP, routing policy, VLANs, and overlays across management, tenant, and external networks. Build Kubernetes-native automation to provision and manage these capabilities through fabric-manager APIs, including customer service exposure, ingress/egress, VIPs, load balancers, and public IPs. Validate convergence, failover, reachability, and isolation. Kubernetes networking: Own networking for the Groq management plane and tenant clusters, including Cilium, network policy, service routing, ingress, egress, and integration with bare-metal networks. GPU networking: Automate tenant configuration and lifecycle operations for GPU networking, including NVL72 systems, InfiniBand, RoCE, and GPUDirect, through supported platform and fabric-management interfaces. Validate connectivity, isolation, and performance as tenant allocations and node membership change. Addressing and fabric integration: Own dynamic address allocation, network inventory integration, and tenant network configuration through IPAM, NetBox, and fabric-manager APIs such as Netris and UFM. Keep intended configuration, applied state, and inventory consistent throughout the tenant and node lifecycle. Tenant isolation and network security: Own segmentation and traffic policy across the Groq management plane, tenant clusters, and physical fabrics. Define permitted communication between environments and verify isolation through provisioning, scaling, maintenance, and hardware reassignment. Work with security engineering on network access controls and hardening requirements. Network standards and configuration lifecycle: Establish addressing, routing, and configuration standards for GroqMetal’s management plane and tenant networks. Implement declarative configuration and continuous reconciliation through Kubernetes-native controllers, fabric-manager APIs, and GitOps, with code review, automated testing and validation, staged rollout, and recovery procedures. Detect and reconcile configuration drift, and maintain tenant isolation as nodes enter, leave, or return to tenant networks during provisioning, repair, and reassignment. Production network reliability: Own network telemetry, troubleshooting, and incident remediation. Diagnose packet loss, routing failures, congestion, and unexpected traffic across hosts, clusters, fabrics, and the edge. Turn recurring incidents and performance findings into prioritized improvements to the managed service. Ideal candidates have/are Deep networking knowledge and production ownership: You have designed and operated networking services on data center infrastructure through deployment, expansion, maintenance, and incidents. You understand TCP/IP, BGP, routing policy, peering, ECMP, segmentation, and interconnects well enough to explain packet paths, diagnose failures, and evaluate the consequences of a configuration change. Bare-metal data center networking expertise: Experience operating leaf-spine fabrics, underlay and overlay networks, and tenant separation using technologies such as VLANs, VRFs, and EVPN/VXLAN. Strong Kubernetes and Linux networking experience: Practical knowledge of CNI behavior, Cilium or comparable systems, network policy, service exposure, and the interaction between cluster networking and physical infrastructure. Kubernetes-native development, network automation, and GitOps experience: You have built Kubernetes controllers, operators, and custom resources in Go. You can integrate network APIs through reconciliation loops that handle retries, partial failures, and resource cleanup safely. You have managed changes through version control, code review, automated testing, and controlled rollout. Experience building multitenant infrastructure or managed Kubernetes products: You have helped deliver Kubernetes networking as a service, including customer onboarding, provisioning, upgrades, scaling, and production support. You can turn customer requirements into supported features with defined behavior, limits, and operational procedures. Experience securing networks that run customer workloads: You have designed and operated tenant separation, management network boundaries, and traffic controls, with practical methods for testing that those controls work. Fabric management and IPAM experience: Netris, UFM, NetBox, or comparable fabric management and IPAM systems. GPU infrastructure expertise: NVIDIA GPU infrastructure and AI networking, including InfiniBand, Spectrum-X, NVL72 systems, RDMA, RoCE, and congestion control. GPU cluster networking experience: Networking for large GPU clusters, including distributed workload performance, high-bandwidth east-west traffic, and multi-site connectivity. Product judgment grounded in networking: You can understand a customer’s requirements, evaluate the network implications, and define a capability the platform can reliably deliver and support. Compensation Groq is committed to providing competitive compensation through our Total Cash philosophy, which incorporates potential bonus value directly into base pay. The total cash salary range for this position, which is inclusive of the potential bonus value, is $270,400 - $401,600, with individual placement determined by your geographic location, experience, skills, and alignment with internal compensation standards. This range is specific to candidates located in the United States. Compensation for international candidates will vary based on local market dynamics. Beyond cash compensation, Groq also offers a Long-Term Incentive (LTI) Program and a robust suite of employee benefits.

review_candidates.description: 📢 People Talk 레고랜드 코리아에서 Technology Operations Technician을 채용합니다. 본 포지션은 담당 지역 내 IT 운영의 안정성을 확보하고, 기술적 이슈를 신속하게 해결하며, 현장 중심의 뛰어난 기술 서비스를 제공하는 역할입니다. 필요 시 지정된 다양한 사업장을 방문하여 지원하게 되며, Technology Operations Manager에게 보고합니다. 또한, 기술 지원의 첫 번째 접점으로서 서비스 요청을 관리하고 IT 프로젝트의 원활한 수행을 지원하는 중요한 역할을 담당합니다. 문제 해결 능력과 기술 전문성을 바탕으로, 내부 고객에게 최고의 고객 경험을 제공할 수 있는 분을 찾고 있습니다. 아래의 Job Description을 참고해 주시기 바랍니다. Key Accountabilities (주요 업무 및 책임) IT 운영 및 지원 -SLA 기준에 따른 기술 장애 및 서비스 요청 대응 -복잡한 이슈 발생 시 적절한 팀으로 에스컬레이션 수행 -IT 시스템 및 서비스에 대한 사전 모니터링 및 예방 대응 -ITSM 시스템을 통한 장애 및 요청 이력 관리 및 문서화 -ITIL 프로세스 기반의 표준화된 서비스 운영 수행 Operational Excellence (운영 효율성) -Global Service Desk와의 협업을 통한 서비스 연속성 확보 -사내 IT 정책 및 절차에 따른 운영 준수 -KPI 관리 및 리포팅을 통한 지속적인 운영 개선 지원 Stakeholder Engagement (이해관계자 협업) -내부 고객 대상 신속하고 친절한 IT 지원 제공 -장애 및 요청 상태에 대한 명확하고 timely한 커뮤니케이션 -프로젝트 및 개선 활동 -로컬 IT 프로젝트 수행 및 실행 지원 -신규 시스템 및 애플리케이션 테스트 및 배포 지원 -서비스 품질 향상을 위한 개선 기회 발굴 및 제안 자격 요건 (Experience & Qualifications) -IT 지원 또는 유관 분야 최소 2년 이상 경력 -EUC, POS, 네트워크 인프라 등 IT 시스템 전반에 대한 이해 -ServiceNow 등 ITSM 툴 사용 경험 -ITIL Foundation 자격 또는 이에 준하는 실무 경험 우대 -다양한 기술 문제를 신속하게 해결한 경험 핵심 역량 (Skills & Competencies) -문제 해결력: 근본 원인을 분석하고 효과적인 해결책 도출 -고객 중심 사고: 높은 서비스 마인드 및 사용자 경험 지향 -커뮤니케이션: 다양한 이해관계자와 원활한 협업 능력 -팀워크: 협업과 독립 업무 수행을 모두 잘하는 능력 -유연성: 변화하는 환경 속에서 우선순위 조정 및 대응 능력 Health & Safety: Employees are responsible for the safety of themselves, their colleagues and guests (where appropriate), in line with the Group Policy (HS001) and the law. In particular, they must ensure that they follow safe working procedures for all work activities that they undertake and they must not use any tools or equipment for which they have not been trained. Where incidents do occur, they must ensure that they are reported to their line manager and must cooperate with any investigation as appropriate. [지원시 유의사항] ‘채용 절차의 공정화의 관한 법률(이하 채용절차법)’에 의거하여, 1) 자격증, 학위 등 증빙자료는 추후 요청 시 제출하게 됩니다. 2) 이력서에 주민등록번호, 가족사항 등의 개인정보를 기재하지 마시기 바랍니다. *당사는 ‘채용절차법’에 의거, 채용 과정 중 업무와 무관한 일체의 개인신상정보를 묻거나 요구하지 않습니다. * [채용일정] 2026.10.22 ~ 채용시 마감 (*서류 제출 순으로 검토되며 빠르게 채용이 마감될 수 있습니다.) [지원방법] 국영문 이력서를 한 파일로 통합하여(PDF 등) 아래 채용담당자 이메일로 지원 [채용과정] 서류전형 → 1차인터뷰 → 평판조회 → 최종면접 → 채용검진 → 최종합격 (상황에 따라 인터뷰 절차가 추가 및 변경될 수 있으며 직무 및 Grade에 따라 개인동의 절차 후 개별 레퍼런스체크가 진행될 수 있습니다.) [Benefits] -Merlin Magic Pass 제공(테마 파크 및 시설 무료 입장) -Enjoy the Ride Pass 제공 (APAC 전역, 연간회원권 지급) -이사비 일부 지원(조건 충족시) -식대 지원 -통신비 지원 -워크샵 및 팀 활동 지원 -단체보험 가입 및 건강검진 지원 -복지포인트 지급 [채용담당자] -김세미, Talent Acquisition Executive Korea

review_candidates.title: Senior VDI Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior VDI Engineer Springfield, VA OR Arnold, MO - Candidates can reside near either location 140k-155k/year TS/SCI Clearance Required - Must be eligible for CI Poly NGA - Contract runs through 2032 Marathon TS is seeking an experienced VDI Engineer to support an intelligence community customer in Springfield, VA or Arnold, MO. This position requires an active TS/SCI security clearance and offers the opportunity to support a large-scale, globally accessible virtual desktop infrastructure within a mission-critical environment. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise VDI environments, with a strong background in system integration, identity lifecycle management, and process automation. The successful candidate will be a motivated self-starter with excellent communication skills, a commitment to operational excellence, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing virtual desktop solutions. Job Description Provide TIER 3/4 support to system administrators in order to resolve VDI issues. Provide guidance on optimization of desktops for platform interoperability and act as liaison between Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) technologies. Offers endpoint support on issues and trouble resolution tasks on Virtual Desktop related tasks. Maintains an Advanced knowledge relative to administration, engineering, and implementation of virtual desktop infrastructure-related technologies. Operate across multiple and complex production environments with multiple stakeholders. Applies extensive technical expertise and has full knowledge of other related disciplines. Required Qualifications Experience providing engineering support for legacy and current versions of Citrix products. 5+ years of experience with BS degree or a combination of years of experience and education. Progressive roles from Administrator to Sr. Engineer. Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops v7.15 and later. Citrix Provisioning Services (PVS) and Machine Creation Services (MCS). Citrix Cloud Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD). Citrix Netscaler / Client / VPX. Citrix Workspace Environment Management (WEM). Citrix App Layering. Liquidware Profile Unity. Hyper V, VMWare VDI (Microsoft or Citrix NetScalers / ADCs). Familiar with Client AnyConnect and Leostream. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing and administering Windows Server clustering Experience with Infrastructure as code technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, etc. System Center Virtual Machine Manager/Vmware Vcenter 6.7 Active Directory/ Group Policies Home Directory and Profile management Support Services Desktop Software provisioning and Support Services MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE TS/SCI Marathon TS is committed to the development of a creative, diverse and inclusive work environment. In order to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals, employment decisions at Marathon TS will be based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. Marathon TS does not discriminate against any person because of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age or any other characteristic protected by law (referred to as "protected status").
